newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling on weak sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling on weak sentiment.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are unlikely to sustain Thursday's gains when the market reopens on Sunday given generally dull sentiment, brokers said.

"There is no good news to bolster the market. The resignation of the chief of the Securities and Exchange Commission would continue to affect already weak market sentiment," said Golam Sarwar of Mahbub Morshed & Co. The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index gained 0.22 points to end at 1,048.02 on a turnover of 33.8 million taka on Thursday. The weekend in Bangladesh falls on Friday and Saturday.
